```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(miloDE)
```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(milo_hsc_obj)
targets::tar_load(milo_within_ngb_pos_neg_de)
targets::tar_load(milo_hsc_da)

de_stat = miloDE::convert_de_stat(milo_within_ngb_pos_neg_de)

```

```{r}
stat_de_magnitude = miloDE::rank_neighbourhoods_by_DE_magnitude(de_stat)

miloDE::plot_DE_single_gene(milo_hsc_obj,
                            milo_within_ngb_pos_neg_de,
                            gene = "Klf1",
                            layout = "umap.nn",
                            alpha = 1)& 
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
        low    = "blue",
        mid    =  "white",
        high   = "red",
        limits =c(-2,2))
```
